title: Add transactional downgrade guard, version pinning and backup/restore verification for private-installer
author: Aisha Kumar
description: Add a transactional downgrade guard to the private installer and supporting upgrade/rollback tooling. This PR implements version pinning for installer components, introduces a verification step for backup/restore during upgrades, and converts the critical Postgres schema migrations into transactional, retryable steps with explicit rollback checkpoints. Motivation: customers running Private deployments reported upgrade regressions when a partial migration ran and an attempted rollback left the DB in an inconsistent state. This change aims to make upgrades and downgrades deterministic and safe when an operator needs to rollback to a prior release. Key pieces: 1) Installer: Helm/Terraform changes that pin component image/chart versions and add a --downgrade-safe flag. 2) Migrations: new transactional migration harness that groups DDL/DDL-ish steps in reversible blocks, with safe checkpoints persisted in a migration_state table. 3) Backup/restore verification: pre-upgrade snapshot + post-restore integrity checks and a small verification utility (scripts/backup-verify.sh) used in CI. 4) Rollback tooling: upgrade/rollback CLI changes to consult migration_state and drive forward/rollback migrations safely. 5) Documentation: migration guide and rollback runbook in docs/upgrade-migration.md. This PR includes unit tests for the migration harness and a migration smoke test that runs against a local Postgres instance in CI. Linear items: ENG-4821 (downgrade guard design), ENG-4872 (migration harness + tests). Related: SUP-9812 (customer report).

merge_commit_message:
Add transactional downgrade guard, version pinning and backup/restore verification for private-installer

- transactional migration harness
- version pinning for charts and terraform modules
- backup verification utility and CI smoke tests
- upgrade/rollback CLI safety checks
- docs and runbook
release_notes: Private installer: safer upgrades and rollbacks. Adds transactional schema migrations with rollback checkpoints, version pinning for installer components, and backup/restore verification. Operators should follow docs/upgrade-migration.md for the new --downgrade-safe flow.
notes_for_releaser: This change touches DB migrations and the installer; coordinate a canary rollout and ensure backups are taken before upgrading. The CLI's --downgrade-safe flag changes default behavior: operators must opt in to enforce extra safety checks during upgrades.
smoke_test_runbook: 1) Take a full DB snapshot. 2) Run `make migration-smoke` in CI staging. 3) Verify migration_state table has expected entries. 4) Test rollback via `installer rollback --to-version=<previous>` and validate app starts and schema is consistent. See docs/upgrade-migration.md for commands.
short_summary: Implements a transactional downgrade guard and related tooling for private installer upgrades, plus tests and docs to ensure safe rollback/restore operations.
